prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Hollowlight game production terrain texture SOURCE sheet, not a scene or whole-map painting. References: first image is the approved earthy clustered-pixel terrain texture quality, second the approved worn machinery sprite that fixes native material/shading style. Make ONE square image split precisely into a 2-column, 2-row grid of FOUR equally sized edge-to-edge material samples, with no gutters, borders, labels, text, icons or lighting pools. TOP LEFT: muted gray-green mountain meadow grass, irregular small blade clusters and earthy gaps, quiet readable low contrast. TOP RIGHT: weathered ochre-brown dirt and fine gravel service-road surface, subtle compacted ruts and small stone clusters, low contrast. BOTTOM LEFT: dark desaturated blue-teal shallow creek water viewed directly from above, restrained current ripples, no banks, no large objects, not glossy. BOTTOM RIGHT: worn gray-brown paving/gravel and faint irregular broken stone fragments, no regular checkerboard, suitable ruined hamlet courtyard. Material-specific deliberate pixel clusters at the same density as the approved terrain reference. Muted cozy melancholic pixel-art survival-game materials, no smooth gradients, no random speckle noise, no isolated hero stones or large plants, no baked environmental shadows or sunlight. Make each quarter internally homogeneous and suitable for tiling after source processing, with texture detail evenly distributed across edges. Similar detail and organic texture quality to reference; keep floor quieter than props. All four samples flat orthographic top-down, no perspective. These four patches will be processed into modular 32-pixel runtime tile variants using our existing palette, not used as a static background.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable production sprite SOURCE sheet for Hollowlight's modular pixel-art mountain surface. Reference image is the approved detailed worn machine sprite; match its deliberate pixel clusters, nuanced muted gray-green/ochre palette, organic silhouettes, weathered material texture, orthogonal top-down three-quarter game view with the same slight visible front face. Create exactly SIX isolated assets, evenly centered in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, generous transparent separation and no overlap between cells. TOP ROW left: one irregular mature mountain pine tree with dense asymmetrical muted green canopy and visibly worn brown trunk, whole tree; middle: one broken waist-high stone and salvaged timber ruin wall segment, crumbling ends, moss and restrained rust, roughly horizontal; right: one shorter ruined stone wall corner with a broken window opening and weathered timber, whole compact modular piece. BOTTOM ROW left: small weathered wooden roadside signpost with a blank unlettered board; middle: short horizontal old bridge deck module of mossy worn wooden planks with simple stone edging, no water or landscape beneath; right: a freestanding rough stone cave-mouth arch made of irregular blocks and roots with a dark open center, no surrounding mountain or landscape. These are single reusable isolated sprites, not scenes/buildings/tileset backgrounds. No characters, no text, no logos, no repeated copies. No baked cast shadows or light pools, no halo outlines. Keep authentic texture and worn materials, not clean geometric placeholders, not random noise. True transparent background, each subject completely inside its cell, with empty margin around it. The game will extract cells, normalize density to two native pixels per world unit and reduce to a shared 64-color palette.
